title_zh: 选定符合房间尺寸的两用桌

scenario.label_zh: 按房间尺寸选择两用桌
scenario.goal_zh: 核对桌面深度及双重用途，并选定较浅的桌款

context_zh: 顾客在家具店为单间公寓挑选既可工作又可用餐的桌子。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: I need a table with a dual purpose: working during the day and eating in the evening.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: This model could do both. What is the largest size that would fit?

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: The important dimension is depth. Anything over sixty centimetres would block the cupboard.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: This one is seventy, but the narrower model is fifty-five.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: Extra space would be desirable, but I need to open the cupboard more than I need a big desk.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Then the narrower one sounds better. Its surface is the same height as this table.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: I will choose the fifty-five-centimetre model. Please show me the available finishes.

targets.sense_zh: 值得拥有的；令人向往的
